source_preservation: All mathematical input arrays and MAT bytes preserved. Public filenames and InstanceName labels use the SF suffix; original names are retained in manifests and OriginalInstanceName. DAT ResultFile metadata is made relative.
legacy_provenance: Maintainer identifies the legacy collection as originating from Zhou et al. (2026), DOI 10.1016/j.cor.2026.107439. The local filenames have not been authenticated against an official supplementary archive.
